# Phone scanner browser libraries

These browser builds are served locally. The scanner can be used without a CDN or an internet connection once the store network is available.

- `zxing-browser.min.js` comes from [@zxing/browser 0.1.5](https://github.com/zxing-js/browser/releases/tag/v0.1.5). It includes code from [@zxing/library](https://github.com/zxing-js/library) and [ts-custom-error](https://github.com/adriengibrat/ts-custom-error). SHA-256 `b5ad3df920738ca7adcb74508d7e6b6a5b9024993fb9a0c702da1ad8964eca07`.
- `qrcode.js` comes from [qrcode-generator 2.0.4](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/releases/tag/js2.0.4). SHA-256 `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`.

The adjacent license files cover the browser builds and their bundled dependencies.
